newsitem.title: USA: CSCE coffee surges as speculators buy, stops hit.
newsitem.headline: CSCE coffee surges as speculators buy, stops hit.

text.p: CSCE coffee prices surged in afternoon trading Tuesday, as speculative buying triggered technical buy-stops, market sources said.
"It's all stops and no selling," one trader said, adding that volume was relatively light at around 8,500 lots.

At 1326 EST, May futures jumped 17.60 cents a lb, to 180.50, after ranging from 181.40 to 160.50. Second-position July was up 16.70 cents, to 170.50, while the remaining months were 5.40 to 6.00 higher.
Traders said no fresh fundamentals emerged today, but that the run up was largely viewed as a technical correction following the market's recent losses.
"It seems like whenever the market comes down viciously and finds some underlying technical support, we go up on nothing," one trader said.
Some traders said although there has been an increase in consumer coffee stocks, the tight supply situation was far from over.
"I think today's move is technical againts the backdrop of tight supplies," another trader said.
